integrity: Theorem proved analytically by the exact Fourier kernel, nonvanishing Cauchy minors and Cauchy--Binet; an independent audit has not been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Assumes exactly one contiguous half-cycle in a finite cyclic group of even order; does not cover uneven or disconnected time windows.
Gives the nullity and full noncentral gap product, but not individual noncentral eigenvalues.
Historical equivalence risk remains for the access-limited 1984 Xu--Chamzas paper; numerical checks do not replace the proof.
title: Half-cycle spectral rigidity and gap products for arbitrary cyclic Fourier masks
